⛽ Inflation has jumped back to 3.1% — the first time above 3% since March.

Look at WHAT pushed it up:
🔺 Motor fuel: +23% on the year
🔺 Electricity, gas & household fuels: +6%
🔻 Food & soft drinks: down to 1.3%

This isn't a supermarket story. It's an energy story — and therefore a getting-to-work story.

The Bank of England decides rates tomorrow. The Budget lands 28 October. And the energy cap still goes up 4% to £1,723 on 1 October, even after the VAT cut.

You can't subsidise your way out of expensive energy. You can only stop making energy expensive. 👇
